title: Dental PPO Plans Time Limits for Claims, Estimates and Appeals
content:
Time limits that apply under each of the Dental PPO Plans to claim filing, pre-treatment estimates and member appeals.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claim filing limit, participating practice (calendar days) | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Claim filing limit, member or non-participating practice (calendar days) | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Estimate recommended above proposed fee of (USD) | 300.00 | 300.00 | 300.00 | 300.00 | 300.00 | 300.00 |
| Estimate validity (calendar days after issue) | 180 | 180 | 180 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Estimate turnaround (business days) | 15 | 15 | 15 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| First-level appeal filing window (calendar days) | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Second-level appeal filing window (calendar days, group only) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Post-service appeal decision, group, each level (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Post-service appeal decision, individual (calendar days) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Pre-service appeal decision, each level (calendar days) | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |

- **Claim filing limits:** calendar days after the date of service within which a participating practice, or a member or non-participating practice, must submit a claim.
- **Estimate recommendation:** pre-treatment estimates are recommended, not required, for proposed treatment whose proposed fee exceeds this amount.
- **Estimate validity:** calendar days after the issue date through which an estimate applies; the last date it applies to is the issue date plus this number of days.
- **Estimate turnaround:** business days (Monday to Friday, excluding federal holidays) from the date received within which an estimate is issued.
- **First-level window:** calendar days after the adverse determination (the decision date of the line, or the issue date of the estimate) within which a first-level appeal may be filed.
- **Second-level window:** calendar days after a first-level decision within which a second-level appeal may be filed; group enrollments only.
- **Decision periods:** calendar days from the filing date to decide each level of a post-service appeal on a group enrollment, the single-level post-service appeal on an individual or individual exchange enrollment, and each level of a pre-service appeal.
